dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge is non-falcate due to extensive structural loss, exhibiting multiple deep notches and irregular pixel boundaries rather than a continuous spline curve.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Small pixel radius, classified as rounded-acute with slight posterior erosion.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree linear incline relative to the horizontal longitudinal axis of the visible dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.8:1 ratio of maximum base width to maximum vertical height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant tissue loss on the trailing edge consisting of one primary deep notch and at least three secondary shallow notches; visible vertical linear scar on the upper lateral surface of the fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced mottled pigmentation transitioning from a dark central fin body to high-contrast reflective silver and light grey patches at the base and along the posterior peduncle.
